metadata.description: Claude Code plugin collection for iOS/Swift development

plugins.name: format-swift
plugins.description: Automatically runs swiftformat after editing Swift files.

plugins.name: apple-dev-docs
plugins.description: Automatically converts developer.apple.com URLs to sosumi.ai for Apple documentation access.

plugins.name: xcstrings-manager
plugins.description: Tools for adding, updating, deleting, and reading translations in iOS .xcstrings files.

plugins.name: xcassets-manager
plugins.description: CRUD management for xcassets colors (Color Set) and images (imageset).

plugins.name: xcode-mcp-cli
plugins.description: CLI wrapper for Xcode MCP tools. Build, test, preview, file management, and documentation search via persistent daemon.
